title: Art Loading Failure Recovery
acceptance: A timeout covers dispatch as well as completion even when all bake slots stall; expected parts and failure states prevent silent partial success.
An asset becoming ready after an initial timeout can recover through a bounded path; failures use an explicit fallback and retain gameplay.
Overlapping Dressing attaches cannot create duplicate/orphaned visuals; failed-part, delayed-bake and cancellation probes plus timing/memory evidence are recorded; check.sh passes.
